- Mateo: finalize target segments (dev + platform engineer buckets) and attach the CSV we should upload.

3) Reminder 1 — T-3 days (Sept 27)
4) Reminder 2 — Day-of morning (Sept 30 08:00 PT) 
5) Final nudge — 1 hour before start (if capacity allows)

I'll consolidate edits into a final send plan. Please reply inline — short notes are fine.

Thanks,
